title: Finite sup-norm nets for uniformly bounded, uniformly Lipschitz sequences on a compact set
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, K ⊆ ℝⁿ compact (ℝⁿ = Euclid n), (g_j)_{j∈ℕ} functions ℝⁿ → ℝ and C ∈ ℝ with |g_j(x)| ≤ C and |g_j(x) − g_j(y)| ≤ C‖x − y‖ for all j and all x, y ∈ K. Then for every δ > 0 there is a finite set S ⊆ ℕ such that for every j there is k ∈ S with |g_j(x) − g_k(x)| ≤ δ for all x ∈ K.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid n)) (g : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ) (C : ℝ), IsCompact K → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K, |g j x| ≤ C) → (∀ j, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, |g j x - g j y| ≤ C * ‖x - y‖) → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ S : Finset ℕ, ∀ j, ∃ k ∈ S, ∀ x ∈ K, |g j x - g k x| ≤ δ
